CarrierRelationResult_x.RELATES: Governed rule applies to declared source/target types in D_rel and positively establishes the relation.
CarrierRelationResult_x.DOES_NOT_RELATE: Governed applicable rule definitively rejects the relation.
CarrierRelationResult_x.UNDEFINED: Applicability, typing, rule meaning, or required inputs are unresolved.

ContextComponentResult_x.ALIGNED: Governed preserve, translate, or restrict rule accepts the component relation.
ContextComponentResult_x.MISMATCH: Governed applicable rule definitively rejects the component relation.
ContextComponentResult_x.UNDEFINED: Rule, applicability, source, target, or translation is unresolved.

BridgeProvenanceValidationResult_x.PROVENANCE_VALID: Artifact, digest/version, rule ID, source location, and authority status are governed and mutually consistent.
BridgeProvenanceValidationResult_x.PROVENANCE_INVALID: A governed identifier, digest, location, or authority assertion is definitively false or unauthorized.
BridgeProvenanceValidationResult_x.UNDEFINED: A required field or authority decision is absent or unresolved.

carrier_aggregation.REPRESENTED: Nonempty applicable set, at least one authoritative RELATES, and no equally authoritative DOES_NOT_RELATE or UNDEFINED.
carrier_aggregation.NOT_REPRESENTED: Nonempty applicable set, every authoritative rule DOES_NOT_RELATE, and none UNDEFINED.
carrier_aggregation.UNDEFINED: Rule set absent, applicability unresolved, any authoritative rule unresolved, or authoritative rules conflict.
carrier_aggregation.authority_exception: Unique-authority precedence is allowed only when explicitly governed.

context_aggregation.CONTEXT_MISMATCH: At least one required component MISMATCH.
context_aggregation.UNDEFINED: No component MISMATCH and at least one required component UNDEFINED.
context_aggregation.rule_set_policy: Apply complete applicable-rule-set or explicitly governed unique-authority semantics independently to boundary, domain, and residue components.

threshold_matrix.overlap_policy: Rows are exhaustive and non-overlapping; no ANY wildcard is used.

DependencyGraphCompletenessRecord_x.purpose: Independently establish that dependency edges were extracted completely from the declared source scope.

dependency_completion.validity: EvalDependencyStage_x may return VALID_PRE_REF_ORIENT only when the graph and completeness record validate.

exact_import_manifest.collision_policy: No descriptive import labels are accepted; same-symbol repairs use explicit supersession.
